arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine has a power failure and says it cannot be fixed (their own online research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and leave with them. Do you consent? If so, how should the existing machine be disconnected, removed or stored (at your cost, not the tenant's)? Or would you prefer we send our contractor to inspect/repair or replace it yourself?
options: Send our contractor to inspect the existing machine first (recommended: confirms whether it is repairable, and it may still be under warranty)

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. Because the machine belongs to the landlord, and a replacement would be a change to the property, we need the landlord's consent first. We've asked them, including what should happen to the current machine. Please don't buy or connect a new one until we confirm. You wouldn't be asked to pay for removing the old machine. If you can, please send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine has a power failure and says it cannot be fixed (their own online research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and leave with them. Do you consent? If so, how should the existing machine be disconnected, removed or stored (at your cost, not the tenant's)? Or would you prefer we send our contractor to inspect/repair or replace it yourself?
options: Send our contractor to inspect the existing machine first (recommended: confirms whether it is repairable, and it may still be under warranty)
Consent to tenant's own machine; tell us what to do with the existing one
Arrange your own contractor or replacement
Decline the tenant's own machine
arguments.update: No visit booked and no contractor assigned. Nothing is committed until you reply. Please reply by 2025-07-30.

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. Because the machine belongs to the landlord, and a replacement would be a change to the property, we need the landlord's consent first. We've asked them, including what should happen to the current machine. Please don't buy or connect a new one until we confirm. You wouldn't be asked to pay for removing the old machine. If you can, please send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July.
